scope: Deep cross-carrier MLEADER content-branch research and plan-readiness update without support promotion.

method.kind: Primary-source research plus local source/test/sample-trace inspection
method.odaSpecification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, local copy, §§20.4.48 and 20.4.86, pages 158-159 and 214-216
localInspection: src/drw_entities.cpp: DRW_MLeader::parseDxfContextCode, parseMLeaderAnnotContext, encodeMLeaderAnnotContext, and DRW_MLeader::validateDxf

Local AC1021 architectural_-_annotation_scaling_and_multileaders.dwg trace; sample bytes were not edited

evidence.topic: ODA DWG branch grammar and context-sensitive code roles
evidence.observed: MLEADER is introduced at DWG version 21 and embeds MLeaderAnnotContext. Entity-level group 172 is content type 0=None, 1=Block, 2=MTEXT, 3=TOLERANCE. Within context, group 172 means text flow direction; nested group 290 meanings depend on root versus context scope, and context group 296 is Has contents block. The DWG context payload follows a conditional text-or-block branch; no TOLERANCE payload grammar appears in the cited context layout.
doesNotEstablish: the complete legal group-172 by context-290/296 cross-product for DXF
that dual-enabled DXF context flags are always invalid
complete TOLERANCE serialization or native rendering
DXF MLEADER support from DWG body-layout rules

evidence.topic: Autodesk DXF descriptions versus tuple validity
evidence.observed: Autodesk documents entity content type separately from context hasMText and HasBlock. The ObjectARX enum names None, Block, MText, and Tolerance content types. The inspected pages do not define a full legality matrix or stale-branch-field rule.
doesNotEstablish: every enum value having a complete libdxfrw payload model
that exactly one of the context flags must be true
native acceptance of generated output

evidence.observed: Current ezdxf source creates/parses MText and Block context payloads independently from group 290 and 296 and writes both flags independently. Its block matrix storage is transposed relative to its Matrix44 model, and its source documents transform limitations.
doesNotEstablish: a normative DXF rule for dual flags
a pinned executable result
AutoCAD, BricsCAD, FreeCAD, or other native consumer acceptance
complete 3D geometry semantics

evidence.observed: The local DXF parser stores branch field values without requiring the associated context flag, while the local writer emits text/block branch fields only when the corresponding flag is set. The existing generated hardening round-trip includes style content type 1 with both context flags true and preserves that tuple locally.
doesNotEstablish: that branch fields without flags occur in valid producer files
that the existing dual-enabled control is a semantically valid MLEADER
a producer/native support result
evidence.planUse: Add a fast generated loss guard: reject before publication or retain payload/handles exactly when branch fields are present under a false flag. Until decided and tested, refuse adapter admission for that state.

evidence.topic: DWG writer boundary and peer maturity
evidence.observed: The local DWG parser selects text or else block payload; the local DWG encoder explicitly rejects block-content context. LibreDWG marks MULTILEADER entity registry stable but MLEADEROBJECTCONTEXTDATA object registry debugging.
doesNotEstablish: complete DWG MLEADER block-context writing
standalone annotative-context object closure
a broad peer parity or support claim

evidence.observed: The available AC1021 drawing produces MLEADER debug traces, but the full read has 36 object parse failures and 13 AC1021 CRC mismatches.
doesNotEstablish: producer-authored tuple validity
semantic geometry correctness
native consumer acceptance

planImpact.nextReadinessSlice: Use the existing focused MLEADER tests to close DXF inactive-branch payload loss with a fail-closed or exact-retention control; keep dual flags as an ambiguity control, preserve type/group scope, and maintain separate DWG block-content refusal until its versioned body/handle route is implemented and independently qualified.
